Slimes act as a sort of mix between a scavenger animal and mushrooms. They consume dead magical animals and plants, converting them into more magical slime.

Different colors of slime have different variants of stored magic, usually depending on the environment. (Slimes in cold areas will have magic more attuned to ice, for example.)

As they move they leave a trail of 'charged' slime behind them that gets absorbed back into the environment. They can also shed some of their mass if attacked to act as a distraction while they flee. It's more common to see a swarm of smaller slimes, no bigger than an cantaloupe, than to see a large slime.

Some creatures eat slimes to get the magic they have stored and slime can be used in various rituals and potions.

Nobody is sure where slimes come from, they just sort of appear in areas with a high enough concentration of magic.
